intro: Colombia is a presidential republic with one of Latin America's longest traditions of elections.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for a single four-year term. Congress has a Senate and a House. Gustavo Petro became the first left-wing president in 2022. Abelardo de la Espriella won the 2026 election and took office in August 2026.

chapters.title: Building peace
text: A special court tries crimes from the conflict, and former fighters have seats in Congress.
